title: Jef's Pirate Update
description: Just some simple structures that feel vanilla while making it seem like a pirates dream!
body:
This data-pack is simpy to give your game that 'pirates life' kinda feel, while feeling vanilla! With pirate ships, lonly villagers out on a raft, pirate outposts, and pirate graves, this is an awesome structure pack centered on pirates!

As of right now it is just a datapack, but I chose to use datapacks because anyone can use it, you don't need a mod loader!

# **Features:**

**Structures:** Three different pirate ships, two rafts, a pirate outpost, debris, and more!

**Loot:** Most of the structures just have dungon loot, this may change in with the next update.

## **NOTES:**

Go's realy well with "Pillager to Pirate" texture pack!
